text_block_list.text:
I could never call myself the fastest, or
number
one, but...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I'll be allowed to if I win the autumn
Tenno Sho...
right?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Then, I can say that I'm the best at
medium
distance, right?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
The autumn Tenno Sho is a
medium-distance G1
race rich in
tradition and prestige. Winning this
will
make Nature a top-class runner both in
name
and reality!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Yup, that's it... I've said it, now there's
no taking
it back!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: No need to tell me twice!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер
